_comment: Sample headless run configuration for scheduled or automated runs. Copy this file, adjust the values, then launch with config=/absolute/path/to/your-launch-config.json.
_usage: CLI values override config-file values. _comment-style fields are ignored by the parser and exist only for documentation.

connection._comment: Choose the transport and destination/bind settings used for the replay session.
connection._grpcHeaderPathKey_comment: grpcHeaderPathKey and grpcHeaderPath are only used when protocol=grpc and mode=client.
connection._httpFormat_comment: httpFormat, httpTls, httpTlsCaPath, httpTlsCertPath, httpTlsKeyPath, httpPath, and httpAllowUnverifiedTls are only used when protocol=http.
connection._allowUnverifiedTls_comment: allowUnverifiedTls, httpAllowUnverifiedTls, and wsAllowUnverifiedTls are client-mode only and default to false. Setting one to true accepts an unverified server certificate for any host, not only localhost.
connection._socketPayload_comment: These Simulator-only settings convert logical CSV source records for TCP or UDP. Formats default to delimited; header flags default to false so the first record remains an event; X/Y fields are optional but must be set together; WKID defaults to 4326.
connection._wsFormat_comment: wsFormat, wsTls, wsPath, wsSubscriptionMsg, wsIgnoreFirstMsg, wsHeaders, and wsAllowUnverifiedTls are only used when protocol=ws.
connection._xmpp_comment: xmppConversation, xmppDomain, xmppTlsPolicy and the other xmpp* keys are only used when protocol=xmpp. protocol=xmpp defaults mode to client and port to 5222 unless they are set explicitly.
connection._xmpp_secrets_comment: xmppPassword, xmppExternalPassword and xmppRoomPassword are read from this file but are never written back by Save Launch Configuration. Treat any file you add them to as a secret. A password may be an empty string for relaxed local testing; only a missing value is an error.

headless._comment: Set runMode to headless (or silent) to run without the UI.

output._comment: Optional logging and completion artifacts for automation, schedulers, or CI.

streaming._comment: Control replay timing, looping, and the active line range.
